## Slide

#### Postoperative 20% Albumin Infusion and Acute Kidney Injury

## Slide

#### Postoperative 20% Albumin Infusion and Acute Kidney Injury

::: {.columns style="display: flex; height: 500px;"}

::: {.column style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 27.5%;"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false" style="font-size: .5em; flex: 1;"}
### POPULATION
**611 Participants**

* 444 Men, 167 Women
* On-pump cardiac surgery
* High risk of AKI
* Mean age, 69 y
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false" style="font-size: .5em; flex: 1;"}
### SETTINGS
**7 Centers** in Australia and Italy
:::

:::

::: {.column style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 27.5%;"}

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon="false" style="font-size: .5em; flex: 1;"}
### INTERVENTION
**Usual Care (n=304)** Routine care at clinician discretion.

**Albumin (n=307)** 300 mL of 20% albumin given over 15 h post-op.
:::

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple" icon="false" style="font-size: .5em; flex: 1;"}
### PRIMARY OUTCOME
Occurrence of AKI within 48h (creatinine) or 7d (baseline).
:::

:::

::: {.column style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 45%;"}

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon="false" style="font-size: .5em; flex: 1;"}
### FINDINGS
Significant **12% increase** in risk of AKI for the 20% albumin group.



```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 5.5
#| fig-height: 4.5
library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(
  Group = factor(
    c("All", "eGFR <60", "eGFR ≥60"),
    levels = c("eGFR ≥60", "eGFR <60", "All")
  ),
  RR = c(1.12, 1.15, 1.08),
  L = c(1.04, 1.07, 0.82),
  U = c(1.21, 1.23, 1.42)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = RR, y = Group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = L, xmax = U),
    height = 0.2,
    color = "#E37222",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 15, color = "#E37222") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Relative Risk (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )
```

:::

:::

:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #666; padding-left: 20px;"} 
Shehabi Y, et al. JAMA Surg. Published online June 11, 2025.

#### FINDINGS
Significant **12% increase** in risk of AKI for the 20% albumin group.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 5.5
#| fig-height: 4.5
library(ggplot2)

df <- data.frame(
  Group = factor(
    c("All", "eGFR <60", "eGFR ≥60"),
    levels = c("eGFR ≥60", "eGFR <60", "All")
  ),
  RR = c(1.12, 1.15, 1.08),
  L = c(1.04, 1.07, 0.82),
  U = c(1.21, 1.23, 1.42)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = RR, y = Group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = L, xmax = U),
    height = 0.2,
    color = "#E37222",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 15, color = "#E37222") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Relative Risk (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f3f0f0ff", color = "#f3f0f0ff"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = "#f3f0f0ff", color = "#f3f0f0ff"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f3f0f0ff", color = "#f3f0f0ff"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```
